related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

observation.source_interface: mncs-environment CLI claim and provider diagnostics

outcome.basis: The verified change gives the specific stale-provider-head error an inspection-first recovery path: reconcile only if the provider change is intended, otherwise review or restore it first. A targeted test verified this diagnostic. The provider consistency check remains fail-closed, and the pre-existing worktree claim remained held during the recorded incident. This change improves guidance only; it does not change claim authorization, refresh provider bindings automatically, or demonstrate that the stale condition will recur less often.

improvement_relation.basis: The implementation classifies a changed declared provider checkout and points to the established Environment reconcile command with inspection-first guidance. The targeted regression test passes for this diagnostic and the existing snapshot-conflict path. No later independent use has been recorded, so effectiveness remains unassessed.
not_measured: whether the guidance reduces claim-command retries across future sessions
whether stale provider checkout declarations recur
whether external authorization prompts or work outcomes change
empirical elimination of stale provider binding failures
whether another agent benefits from the diagnostic
changes to the broader authorization or claim policy
